capabilities: Render year-long habit tracker calendars in dataviewjs blocks
Map dates to completion values via a Date-to-number function
Customize value colors with CSS snippets
disambiguation: Not a date or task calendar; it renders read-only tracker grids from values you compute with dataviewjs.
extras: All customization is done through CSS snippets; missing CSS for a value shows as saturated pink (#FF00FF). The README also covers building and testing the plugin locally.
intentEvidence: The layout is inspired by Simone Giertz's Every Day Calendar
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize per-day task or habit completion as a physical-style calendar grid.

relations.evidence: the idea to make a plugin in the first place from Richard Slettevoll's Heatmap Calendar
You need the Dataview plugin for dataviewjs blocks to work

summary: Renders year-long habit tracker calendars, styled after Simone Giertz's Every Day Calendar, inside dataviewjs code blocks.
